summary: I am a student and research assistant at the LMU Munich. One of my primary fields of research is the overlap between Quantum Computing and AI, having worked on projects connecting Deep Learning models with Quantum Algorithms for Siemens and the LMU. Explainable AI is another personal point of interest, especially as a tool for AI Safety and Governance.

positions.title: Machine Learning Researcher
positions.description:
As a Machine Learning Researcher at Lyceum, my goal is to work on the task of runtime prediction. The goal is to create a model capable of predicting different properties of a program, such as the expected runtime on different hardware, the memory consumption or the latency. 

For this task, I'll first improve and optimize an existing pipeline capable of taking any snippet of code (for now optimized to deep learning models), and estimate the runtime of the given code, or in this case, the training / inference time of the model. Later, I will create my own pipeline, managing large training data and proposing alternative, state-of-the-art architectures.

company.description: relAI’s research mission is to train future generations of AI experts in Germany who combine technical brilliance with awareness of the importance of the reliability of AI. As a central component of the Munich AI ecosystem, relAI is committed to making artificial intelligence more safe, secure, responsible and protective regarding the privacy of individuals. It encourages responsible use to exploit AI’s vast potential for the benefit of humanity, to advance insight into and debate on machine learning including its ethical and societal dimensions, and to strengthen “AI made in Germany”.
